audience: nonprofits and fundraisers who track donations and donors in Zeffy

useCases.title: Track donations by campaign
useCases.text: List donations and other payments, newest first, with campaign and fund. List the campaigns with their status and goal.

useCases.title: Open one payment and its refund state
useCases.text: Get one payment with its items, refunds, dispute state and receipt link.

useCases.title: Look up a donor and their giving total
useCases.text: Find a contact by exact email, or by created or updated time. Read the total contribution and donation dates.

useCases.title: Review the team members and their roles
useCases.text: List the organization's users with their role and status. Open one user for name and email.

useCases.title: Create or update a donor's contact details
useCases.text: Create or update a contact by email, which is safe to repeat. Writes need the organization's Stripe verification in Zeffy.
